design: 200 instances; each carries two worlds sharing a level set with equal level masses and a perturbation of designed leakage order 1, 2 or 3 built from a Prouhet-Thue-Morse pair; the order is verified independently from the level coefficients; H^2 between the two worlds by quadrature on a 14-point grid to h=6.5e-4; slope fitted on the asymptotic tail (h <= 0.023) with the full-grid fit reported alongside
